simple.question: The neighborhood where Chung-Ang University is located is called Heukseok.
simple.explanation: Chung-Ang University's main Seoul campus is situated in Heukseok-dong, Dongjak-gu.

simple.question: The official mascot of Chung-Ang University is named Ping.
simple.explanation: CAU's official mascot is a blue dragon named Puang (푸앙), not Ping.

simple.question: On the Seoul subway, Line 2 (the green line) is a circular line that forms a complete loop around the city.
simple.explanation: Seoul Subway Line 2 operates as a circular loop connecting major central districts and transit hubs.

simple.question: South Korea has previously hosted the Olympic Games.
simple.explanation: South Korea hosted both the 1988 Summer Games in Seoul and the 2018 Winter Games in Pyeongchang.

simple.question: South Korea is the Olympic champion in archery, men or women.
simple.explanation: South Korea holds dominant Olympic archery titles, regularly sweeping individual and team gold medals.

simple.question: The Greater Seoul area (including Incheon and Gyeonggi Province) accounts for more than 50% of South Korea's total population.
simple.explanation: Over 26 million residents live in the Seoul Capital Area, exceeding half of the country's population.

simple.question: In South Korea, April 14th is known as 'Black Day.'
simple.explanation: Black Day is an unofficial holiday where singles gather to wear black and eat jajangmyeon.

simple.question: The highest mountain in South Korea is located near Sokcho: Mount Seoraksan.
simple.explanation: South Korea's highest peak is Mount Hallasan (1,947 m) on Jeju Island; Seoraksan (1,708 m) ranks third.

simple.question: The South Korean series Squid Game is the most-watched series on Netflix.
simple.explanation: Squid Game remains Netflix's most-watched series of all time by total viewers and hours watched.

simple.question: In Japan, some people eat KFC chicken during Christmas Eve as a 'traditional' meal.
simple.explanation: Eating KFC on Christmas Eve became an enduring Japanese tradition following a successful 1974 marketing campaign.

simple.question: The Eiffel Tower is 385 meters tall.
simple.explanation: The Eiffel Tower stands at 330 meters tall, including its tip and antennas.

simple.question: The bagel was invented in Poland.
simple.explanation: Historical records confirm bagels originated within the 16th-17th century Jewish community of Krakow, Poland.

medium.question: The president will go on a university exchange program to Italy next year.
medium.explanation: The president is going to go to France, not Italy.

medium.question: Kimchi can be made with almost everything, but watermelon kimchi does not exist.
medium.explanation: Watermelon rind kimchi (subak-kkakdugi) is an established Korean culinary preparation.

medium.question: The Korea Club has existed for more than 10 years.
medium.explanation: The organization has maintained active operations for over a decade.

medium.question: The Korean first name of President MK is Min-Kwon (민권).
medium.explanation: Min-Kwon (민권) is not President MK's Korean given name.

medium.question: Carrots were originally purple, white, or yellow; the orange carrot we eat today was bred in the Netherlands in honor of the Dutch royal family.
medium.explanation: Early cultivars were predominantly purple and yellow; 16th-17th-century Dutch growers popularized orange strains honoring the House of Orange.

medium.question: There are so many coffee shops in Seoul that there's 1 café per 500 inhabitants.
medium.explanation: Seoul has approximately 9.3 million people and more than 20,000 cafés, resulting in roughly one café per 465 inhabitants.

hard.question: The largest bridge spanning the Amazon River is located near Leticia in Colombia, featuring foundations over 20 meters deep.
hard.explanation: No bridge crosses the main stem of the Amazon River anywhere along its entire course.

hard.question: Located in Nice, the Marc Chagall National Museum welcomes over 50,000 visitors from around the world each year.
hard.explanation: The Musée National Marc Chagall in Nice consistently records well over 50,000 visitors annually.

hard.question: Sweden has more islands within its territory than Indonesia.
hard.explanation: Sweden contains over 267,000 islands, the most globally, compared to Indonesia's approximately 17,500.
